cases.name: Jade Alan Remold
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Jade graduated from Yankton High School and was the youngest of three daughters. She was a beautiful mother to her baby boy, Alvin Rembold. Her life was dedicated to being the best mother. She will be greatly missed by all those who knew her big, beautiful smile."
